name: QuranEnc translation and Tafsir API
conditions: Unchanged content, publisher/source and edition version attribution, preserve transcript information, follow latest version, no inappropriate advertising. No corpus bundled. Runtime catalog refresh and version-keyed bounded caching; editions lacking publisher version are linked to source instead of republished.
status_note: Arabic Moyassar and Bengali Zakaria ayah APIs respond, but official translations/list omits their edition versions on review date. Inline republication remains unavailable unless current publisher version metadata is verified.
